layers.description: Exercise AgentApplicationService with a local fake provider and assert AgentEvent ordering.
Exercise CLI JSONL output with the built-in mock provider.
Exercise CLI -> Bridge SSE streaming with a local fake Bridge.
Ask through CLI, receive a tool-style code artifact from fake Bridge, compile and run it locally.
Replay a captured loose tool JSON shape, recover the code artifact, compile it, and keep the protocol gap visible.
Optional CLI JSONL -> real Bridge -> DeepSeek Web coding smoke; the final chat.completed response is compiled and run locally.

cases.reason: pass --real-deepseek or DEVSEEK_AGENT_LOOP_REAL_DEEPSEEK=1 to run live DeepSeek CLI smoke

caseDesignReview.limitation: Covers event protocol only; it does not prove tool execution, repair, or UI state.
caseDesignReview.nextCaseImprovement: Add replay fixtures for tool events, evidence, history, and QualityGate transitions.

caseDesignReview.limitation: Covers machine-readable CLI output; it does not validate Bridge or generated code quality.
caseDesignReview.nextCaseImprovement: Add negative JSONL cases for stderr pollution and malformed event ordering.

caseDesignReview.limitation: Covers SSE transport with a fake Bridge; it does not validate live Provider behavior.
caseDesignReview.nextCaseImprovement: Add timeout, reset, and partial-delta replay cases.

caseDesignReview.limitation: Covers a single-file compile/run path; it does not test modifying existing projects or multi-file builds.
caseDesignReview.nextCaseImprovement: Add modify-existing, failing-build repair, and multi-file project fixtures.

caseDesignReview.limitation: Covers one known loose JSON shape; it does not prove all malformed tool outputs are recoverable.
caseDesignReview.nextCaseImprovement: Add more captured live responses as replay fixtures only after each one has a clear oracle.

caseDesignReview.limitation: Live DeepSeek was intentionally skipped, so this run cannot evaluate model protocol adherence.
caseDesignReview.nextCaseImprovement: Run verify:agent-loop-eval:real when Bridge login state is available.

iterationDecision: No DevSeek defect was exposed by this run; treat it as a baseline signal and add harder failure-injection cases next.
